tldr: The Sun in Aries: identity built through courage, initiation, and direct self-assertion.
body: With the Sun in Aries, the core self strengthens when you act, choose, begin, and trust the first honest impulse. You are here to develop courage without needing permission to move.
gift: Leadership, bravery, independence, and the ability to begin what others only discuss.
challenge: Impulsiveness, self-focus, and pushing forward before checking whether the direction is worth the force.
note: Authored from approved project planet-through-sign material.
